_comment: dbpedia-entities-openai-1M (1536d cosine). High-dim SPANN: posting_vector_limit auto-derives to ~10 from `dim` so each posting is ~60 KB (NVMe IO sweet spot) instead of SPTAG's 118 default which would push every posting to ~720 KB at 1536d. posting_page_limit/search_posting_page_limit set to 20 — above the 16-page physical floor (`ceil(10 * (1536*4+4) / 4096)`) with headroom. head_ratio=0.30 — high-dim SPANN is more sensitive to head quality, 300k centroids covers the 1M base well. internal_result_num=128 / max_check=16384 widen search candidates. num_threads/io_threads=32 caps build wall-clock.
